title: ARWP Search and AI Measurement Patterns
scope: Operational patterns for observing Search/AI discovery with provider-native evidence. These are measurement patterns, not additions to the versioned discoverability corpus unless separately reviewed there.

patterns.title: Measure Google generative exposure from the dedicated report
patterns.implementation: Import the dedicated Search Console Generative AI performance export. Generic Web Search impressions are a different population and must not be relabeled as AI impressions.
usefulDerived: aiImpressions / aiVisiblePages within the same report period
patterns.guardrail: Do not infer citations, visits or conversions from generative impressions alone.

patterns.title: Keep Bing grounding queries attached to cited pages
patterns.implementation: Preserve page- and query-level evidence privately when available, then aggregate only for the public/portable visibility snapshot.
usefulDerived: totalCitations / citedPages within the same Bing observation window
patterns.guardrail: Grounding-query samples are provider observations, not a complete demand universe.

patterns.title: Preserve AI referral source and UTM evidence
patterns.implementation: Match identifiable AI referrers and provider UTM source values in first-party analytics. Preserve the source dimension before aggregating sessions or visits.
patterns.guardrail: Some AI-origin visits may be unattributed; measured referrals are an observable lower-bound-like signal, not total AI influence.

patterns.title: Measure AI crawler access before guessing about retrieval
patterns.implementation: Use Cloudflare AI Crawl Control or equivalent edge/server evidence to inspect crawler traffic, allowed/blocked state, response codes and requested paths.
patterns.guardrail: Crawler access proves neither indexing nor citation.

patterns.title: Break crawler/retrieval evidence down by content format
patterns.implementation: Where edge tooling exposes negotiated or served content format, compare formats as an operational retrieval signal rather than assuming Markdown or another representation is intrinsically preferred.
patterns.guardrail: Format traffic is not evidence of a ranking advantage. Keep canonical facts equivalent across representations.

patterns.title: Separate search/answer retrieval policy from model-training policy
patterns.implementation: Track provider crawler identities and publisher policy by purpose. For OpenAI, Search retrieval and model-training crawler controls are separate; other providers may expose different semantics.
patterns.guardrail: Do not treat all AI user agents as one interchangeable permission class.

patterns.title: Use access → exposure → citation → visit → task as an observability model
patterns.implementation: Place provider-native metrics in the stage they actually observe. Report missing stages explicitly and preserve provider provenance.
patterns.guardrail: The stages are not a mathematical funnel unless the same population can be joined end to end. Do not compute cross-provider conversion rates.

patterns.title: Derive ratios only inside a compatible provider population
patterns.implementation: Only derive a ratio when numerator and denominator come from the same provider, compatible scope and observation period, or have an explicit join key.
patterns.guardrail: Never divide Bing citations by Google impressions or AI referrals by crawler requests and call it conversion.

patterns.title: Measure a bounded page cohort before scaling generated pages
patterns.implementation: For data/knowledge sites, start with a reviewed priority cohort and comparable unchanged pages where practical. Scale only after the page-value gate and outcome review survive the first observation window.
patterns.guardrail: Raw page count, indexed URL count or schema volume is not the success metric.

patterns.title: Measure whether deep entity pages contribute useful discovery
patterns.implementation: Tag the priority entity/deep-page cohort and report its contribution separately for each provider/outcome surface.
patterns.guardrail: Do not collapse surface-specific shares into one blended authority score.

patterns.title: Observe freshness lag instead of simulating freshness
patterns.implementation: For materially changed pages, preserve the source change/deploy timestamp and, where evidence permits, the first later crawler or visibility observation. Compare lag distributions by page cohort.
patterns.guardrail: Do not update dates or sitemap lastmod without a meaningful content change merely to improve this metric.

patterns.title: Test agent tasks through semantic/accessibility surfaces
patterns.implementation: Evaluate representative tasks using semantic HTML and accessible names/roles. Treat agent-specific metadata as an enhancement, not a substitute for a usable accessibility tree and ordinary web controls.
patterns.guardrail: A successful controlled task is runtime evidence for that task/configuration, not universal agent compatibility.

patterns.title: Record regional availability before comparing Search/AI outcomes
patterns.implementation: When a Search/AI feature has regional or language availability differences, retain the country/locale slice and avoid comparing populations that were not equally eligible.
patterns.guardrail: A regional absence may be eligibility/availability, not a page-quality failure.
